next.reason: 1985: "an elementary item described as an integer"; 2023: "If the value of arithmetic-expression-1 does not result in an integer" (§2023:14.9.39.4 GR2). An integer sender is now an arithmetic expression whose non-integer value is a run-time EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT, not a compile-time refusal; identifier-2 is an index item, and a numeric identifier-1 still needs index-name-2 (§2023:14.9.39.3 SR4).
